exposure: late arrival in the labor ward
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission for neonatal asphyxia or infection
cohort: 240 women carrying live term singletons in vertex presentation
finding: Late arrival in the labor ward was associated with an increased risk of maternal and neonatal morbidity, including lower genital tract lacerations, PPH, and neonatal intensive care unit admission for asphyxia or infection, despite a reduced risk of Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Late arrival in the labor ward was associated with a reduction in the cesarean section risk.
